capabilities: Render AsciiMath in dollar-sign inline and display math blocks
Insert AsciiMath symbols from a searchable command
Convert AsciiMath to LaTeX in a file or the whole vault
Migrate notes from the plugin's old inline-math syntax
extras: The plugin's pre-0.7 inline syntax is deprecated and will be removed; migration commands exist to convert old notes. Some AsciiMath rules, especially matrices, are noted as not fully consistent with the spec.
intentEvidence: A handy plugin that integrates with default Obsidian math, bringing AsciiMath power to your vault.
motivation: AsciiMath has simpler syntax than LaTeX, and the author wants to speed up math editing in the vault.
problem: Obsidian's math blocks only understand LaTeX, whose syntax is heavier to type than AsciiMath.
summary: AsciiMath support plugin that renders AsciiMath notation inside Obsidian's dollar-sign math blocks and code blocks, with symbol insertion and LaTeX conversion commands.
